title: 05 Empty States
subtitle: Every place that starts with nothing — Home, project, canvas, artboard, panels, search, and the edge cases
brief: empty states — an empty state says what's missing, why it's fine, and ONE next step (often an AI chip + one action); spot art + SF Rounded for playful moments; no "Oops", no exclamation marks; "nothing is deleted" means Trash and Version history always exist. Drawn inside the real window on Studio site and Alligators brand.

sections.title: First moments
sections.subtitle: A brand-new Home, project, canvas and artboard — the prompt comes first, and an empty canvas is always one key away

sections.title: Panels with nothing in them yet
sections.subtitle: Each panel at its real size — same three parts, sat in the upper third; no button when there's nothing to do

sections.title: Search that finds nothing

artboards.label: 1 · Home — signed in, no projects yet
artboards.note: The prompt does the work; “Start with an empty canvas ⌘N” is the way in without AI; ghost cards show the empty shelf.

artboards.label: 2 · Home — a local project, not signed in
artboards.note: Same prompt and ⌘N; the chip says it stays on this Mac; the shelf offers Open project… ⌘O; Sign in waits top right.

artboards.label: 3 · Home — nothing shared with you yet
artboards.note: Your project on its shelf; “Shared with you” keeps its place in ghost cards and names who fills it; no button.

artboards.label: 4 · A new project with no canvases
artboards.note: Panel says no canvases yet; the canvas offers the prompt and Start with an empty canvas ⌘N; no toolbar.

artboards.label: 5 · A new canvas — online, AI ready
artboards.note: Spot art + the CONTRACT empty-canvas line; the stickies land once on the DS spring; Ask AI is the one spark button.

artboards.label: 6 · How the empty canvas arrives — one drop of spring
artboards.note: Static filmstrip of --dur-spring · --ease-spring: only the stickies move; the words and Ask AI are there from frame 1.

artboards.label: 7 · New canvas — AI ready · offline · AI not connected yet
artboards.note: Line and Ask AI never change; offline queues the prompt; not connected opens the one Connect sheet at the first send.

artboards.label: 8 · Empty artboard after “New artboard”
artboards.note: A hint floats on the fresh artboard with one AI chip; Layers says what will appear there.

artboards.label: 9 · Canvases folder · Comments · all resolved · Version history
artboards.note: Empty folder offers New canvas in 2027; Comments teaches C; “All done.” celebrates with confetti; history has no button.

artboards.label: 10 · AI chat · Assets · Exports · Trash
artboards.note: AI chips fit Pricing; Assets — the left panel's third tab — is a drop zone + Generate an image; Exports offers Export…; Trash keeps things until you clear them out.

artboards.label: 11 · Timeline on a video artboard with no clips
artboards.note: Selecting the video artboard summons the timeline; the track is the drop zone; one AI chip cuts from 38 clips.

artboards.label: 12 · ⌘K — nothing called “pricng”
artboards.note: The CONTRACT no-results line with spot art, then Did you mean Pricing, then Ask AI.

artboards.label: 13 · ⌘K with nothing recent · Assets search with no hits
artboards.note: Search on day one says “Nothing opened yet.” and lists where to start; the Assets tab searches names and tags, and offers once to let AI describe the pictures (your Claude account).

artboards.label: 14 · Panel search — 93 canvases, none match
artboards.note: “sponzoři 2024” matches no name; the one next step is AI, which looks inside canvases; the foot says what was searched.

artboards.label: 15 · A filter that hides every artboard
artboards.note: Print filter carried over from Combine-kampan; “No print artboards in Combine-invite” + Clear filter; artboards stay, dimmed.

artboards.label: 16 · A shared canvas you can comment on, not edit
artboards.note: Can comment: the same Select · Hand · Comment toolbar as 04 · md-comment-only, no AI chat panel; the Share cluster says Can comment, the switch reads Viewing, Ask to edit goes to the owner. Uniformy-2027's real 16:9 digital boards.

artboards.label: 17 · The cloud copy hasn't arrived yet
artboards.note: Every canvas listed by name, dimmed with a pulsing thumb; skeleton artboards keep their names and sizes — never an empty project.

artboards.label: 18 · Offline, and this canvas was never downloaded
artboards.note: Plain words, the cloud copy is safe; canvases on this Mac stay bright; one button filters to them.

artboards.label: 19 · Every artboard moved to the trash
artboards.note: Dashed outlines keep their places; a bracket ties them to Restore 4 artboards; who and when; Version history too.

artboards.label: 20 · Chat search with no hits · a team of one
artboards.note: Chat search says what it searched + Start a chat about it; the Share sheet's empty people list is the reason to Invite.
